message.content:
Tan trench coat, relaxed fit, knee-length cut, beige with hex code #dcbfa0, heavy cotton twill fabric.
Merino wool turtleneck sweater, slightly fitted silhouette, length ending at hip bone, warm terracotta with hex code #e29578, soft brushed knit fabric.
Wide-leg trousers in dark denim, straight leg cut, ankle-length hem, charcoal blue with hex code #36454f, durable rigid cotton fabric.
Leather loafers, classic Penny loafer style, rounded toe, chestnut brown with hex code #8c5a4b, smooth full-grain leather material.
Gold layered chain necklace and simple hoop earrings in polished yellow gold metal finish to satisfy the jewelry wish.

This outfit perfectly balances the relaxed autumn day at the park with a touch of intention for a first date. The tan coat provides essential warmth against the fall chill while keeping the silhouette fluid for strolling through trees, while the dark denim trousers ground the look in everyday comfort without sacrificing style. The warm terracotta sweater complements her skin tone and adds a cozy, inviting pop of color that reflects the red jewelry wish. Finally, the loafers offer practical support for walking on uneven paths while maintaining a polished, neat aesthetic suitable for sharing coffee afterward.
